Order, Pickup, Plant
Place your order online and Al's fulfills it within 48 hours. When your order is ready, you get an email. Your order is not fulfilled before that email arrives.
Pick up at the Woodburn or Sherwood location you chose at checkout. Al's holds ready orders for 7 days, and local delivery is also available with fees based on destination and order size.
Returns run 14 days with your receipt. Winter hardy perennials, trees and shrubs are guaranteed for one year, and houseplants, annuals and edibles are guaranteed for 30 days, with a one time replacement or store credit if a plant dies in the window.
